checks.lead: George Herbert Walker Bush (June 12, 1924 – November 30, 2018) was the 41st president of the United States from 1989 to 1993. A member of the Republican Party, he served as Ronald Reagan's vice president from 1981 to 1989. Bush was a pragmatist with myriad political experience, having previously held the offices of Director of Central Intelligence, Chair of the Republican National Committee, and U.S. Ambassador to China and the United Nations.
